scope: Headless Chromium; production Svelte components and deterministic mocked IPC. No real models, WGC, HWND, OS focus or click-through verification.
checks: Preview renders completed Chinese captions with native overlay disabled
Preview captions follow image zoom and fit
Preview toggle works; a different live image cannot inherit old captions
Native subtitle toggle updates settings without model/inference calls; saved setting events synchronize the control
Real standalone renderer paints, acknowledges layout and rejects a delayed snapshot after clearing
Renderer diagnostics distinguish mount, viewport wait and IPC failure; resizing releases the acknowledgement gate
